caseName: Newark Fire Insurance Co. v. State Board of Tax Appeals
caseNameFull: Newark Fire Insurance Co. v. State Board of Tax Appeals and Universal Insurance Co. v. Same

opinions.text:
It is ordered that the opinion of Mr. Justice Reed entered on May 29,' 1939, be corrected by striking therefrom the words at the end thereof:

“The judgments in both cases are affirmed.”

Reported as amended, ante, p. 313.
